reviewMethod: Review of cached official PDF table text and rendered primary pages 50, 54, 56, 60 and 64. Promotion limited to exact table/colour-variant identity, published matched monosplit pairing and its 1-port topology, casing dimensions, cooling high-fan volume flow and informational nominal cooling capacity. All other Qwen candidate facts remain unaccepted. EF18 is multisplit-only, excluded. Colour variants B/W/S explicitly share the EF family table; unknown compressor maps, UA, heat-exchanger surface, motor watts and heating fan flow remain generic/unknown. Cooling published high-fan flow reused in heating is an explicit scenario assumption. Published operating-range endpoints promoted as metadata with their original dry/wet-bulb table conditions; not an inferred dynamic protection envelope. Follow-up LN review: primary text and image PDF p.68; LN18 multisplit-only excluded. The explicit header lists colour variants VG3R/B/V/W above the shared family specification table: selected physical casing/airflow and informational capacities use that family table, not invented per-colour measurements. FT follow-up review: primary text and image PDF p.72 confirms exact VGK2 indoor / VGHZ2 outdoor monosplit pairings, cooling highest-fan airflow, casing and range endpoints. Hyper Heating cold-weather capacity rows remain informational candidate ratings, not an inferred compressor map. Daikin Stylish follow-up: independently read official cached2022 installer PDF page42 text/image. Promote only FTXA25/35/42/50 explicit AW/BS/BT/BB variants, respective RXA25A9/35A9/42B/50B matched monosplits, casing, cooling high-fan flow for indoor units, and outdoor operating ranges. Outdoor airflow is unpublished and remains generic/manual, explicitly labelled. FTXA20 rejected pending correction: the shared15/20 cooling high fan is11.0m³/min, not11.5. CTXA15 is multisplit-only, not promoted here. Current2026 availability unestablished.
